decisions.reason: As a recently launched but still core-adjacent lubrication system backed by visible launch effort, management is likely to continue it and blame any weak uptake on temporary customer investment delays rather than abandon it quickly.

This hydrocyclone coolant filter fits very closely with the firm's established filtration and fluid-handling business, so sunk development effort and strategic fit make continued support more likely than withdrawal.

The gravity band coolant filter is a natural extension of the firm's modular core offer, and an expanding German machinery firm with public commitment to such products would usually persist rather than cut it after only a short market presence.
